name: rapidfuzz_ratio
description: Levenshtein-based similarity (0–100). The headline metric — same as Python `rapidfuzz.fuzz.ratio`.

name: rapidfuzz_partial_ratio
description: Best similarity score for any substring of the longer input against the shorter — useful when one string is a fragment of the other.

name: rapidfuzz_token_sort_ratio
description: Compare after sorting tokens (words). Matches strings whose words appear in different orders.

name: rapidfuzz_token_set_ratio
description: Compare token sets (deduped, unordered). Tolerates duplicated words.

name: rapidfuzz_partial_token_set_ratio
description: Token-set comparison with a partial-ratio fallback — best when one string is a subset/partial match of the other.

name: rapidfuzz_hamming_distance
description: Number of differing positions between two equal-length strings. Raw count of edits required.

name: rapidfuzz_hamming_similarity
description: Number of differing positions between two equal-length strings. Raw count of matches.

name: rapidfuzz_hamming_normalized_distance
description: Number of differing positions between two equal-length strings. Edit distance scaled to [0, 1] — 0 means identical.

name: rapidfuzz_hamming_normalized_similarity
description: Number of differing positions between two equal-length strings. Similarity scaled to [0, 1] — 1 means identical.

name: rapidfuzz_indel_distance
description: Insertions+deletions to transform one string into another (no substitutions). Raw count of edits required.

name: rapidfuzz_indel_similarity
description: Insertions+deletions to transform one string into another (no substitutions). Raw count of matches.

name: rapidfuzz_indel_normalized_distance
description: Insertions+deletions to transform one string into another (no substitutions). Edit distance scaled to [0, 1] — 0 means identical.

name: rapidfuzz_indel_normalized_similarity
description: Insertions+deletions to transform one string into another (no substitutions). Similarity scaled to [0, 1] — 1 means identical.

name: rapidfuzz_jaro_distance
description: Jaro similarity — character matches and transpositions. Good for short strings and typos. Raw count of edits required.

name: rapidfuzz_jaro_similarity
description: Jaro similarity — character matches and transpositions. Good for short strings and typos. Raw count of matches.

name: rapidfuzz_jaro_normalized_distance

name: rapidfuzz_jaro_normalized_similarity

name: rapidfuzz_jaro_winkler_distance
description: Jaro-Winkler — Jaro with extra weight on common prefixes. Strong default for names. Raw count of edits required.

name: rapidfuzz_jaro_winkler_similarity
description: Jaro-Winkler — Jaro with extra weight on common prefixes. Strong default for names. Raw count of matches.

name: rapidfuzz_jaro_winkler_normalized_distance

name: rapidfuzz_jaro_winkler_normalized_similarity

description: Longest common subsequence — preserves character order but not adjacency. Raw count of edits required.
